title: SymbolicSystem.Equations: flags for the results, the mass matrices of the bodies, no residual
author: Claude-JG
description: revision2026c step RG12.51.12 (maintainer 2026-10-28: flags for the terms of Equations, what forces means with and without the inverse per body, remove the residual): Equations(massMatrix, forces, massMatrixBlocks) returns what is asked for; massMatrixBlocks the mass matrices of the bodies as MassMatrixBlocks, also recorded for the composed system so that the inverse per body is one call; the residual removed from Equations and GetFlatProgram, which writes the results asked for as a function of q, q_t, t; the docstring says what f is.
releaseNotes: exudyn.misc.symbolicSystem: SymbolicSystem.Equations(massMatrix, forces, massMatrixBlocks) returns the results asked for, with the mass matrices of the bodies for the inverse per body, also recorded for the composed system; the residual removed; GetFlatProgram(results) writes a function Equations(q, q_t, t)
